$comment: Shape overlays on the golden window (mock-app.html `shape=ID`, `bun run golden:looks --shapes`): each one is drawn over a look (cmux's by default) and changes only the chrome's shapes, so the options of one area compare in the same window as every look. `theme` is what a theme file says to ship it: `appearance.*` and other look keys, and `density` with Density Playground tokens (DensityTokenCatalog). `proposed` holds keys that do not exist yet; the window draws them and the sheet names them as proposed. `area` groups the options into one sheet each.

areas.title: Tabs and sidebar rows
areas.note: The selected tab and the selected sidebar row, one shape for both (appearance.tabShape, then the square corner from the density tokens).

areas.title: Sidebar width
areas.note: The sidebar's width (density token sidebarWidth); its rows grow with it.

areas.title: Session Info
areas.note: Where Session Info sits beside the chat (agentPane.display.sessionInfo.placement); text is never covered.

areas.title: Top right buttons
areas.note: The buttons at the right of a pane's tab strip (tabs.toolbarButtons) and their style.

areas.title: Home cards
areas.note: The cards on Home and their material.

shapes.title: Rounded
shapes.note: Capsule tabs and rows that stay on the strip.

shapes.title: Gooey
shapes.note: The selected tab and row run into the pane on two tones, flaring into it through concave corners.

shapes.title: Square
shapes.note: Block tabs with 2 pt corners: the blocky look, from the density tokens.

shapes.title: Docked
shapes.note: Session Info pushes the chat aside, full height, behind a divider.

shapes.title: Floating card
shapes.note: Session Info floats as a card; the chat keeps a lane free for it, so no text sits under it.

shapes.title: Inline
shapes.note: Session Info as one band of facts over the chat.

shapes.title: Plain icons
shapes.note: Bare glyphs; a fill only on hover.

shapes.title: Grouped pill
shapes.note: One filled pill holds the buttons.

shapes.title: Glass capsule
shapes.note: A glass capsule with a rim over the strip.

shapes.title: Flat
shapes.note: Tonal fill, no edge, no shade.

shapes.title: Raised
shapes.note: A card with a hairline and a soft shadow.
